result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 195 is a second small fix-up for STORE-2a (the store colour stage). It is not a regression round yet, because that is due at the first planning on or after 2026-10-27 and today is 2026-10-26.

**What round 194 showed (C failed it, with real browser checks):**
- All 13 granted changes worked in the browser. The email placeholder in the free-download popup is now 5.10:1. The store text-field borders measure 3.12–3.70:1. Store layout, the keep-list texts and the Studio (0 changed pixels) were unchanged.
- **C-R194-01 (Medium):** the guest chat form on `/support` still has faint field borders, 1.21:1. It was 1.62:1 before round 193, so round 193 caused it, and round 194 did not grant that file.
- **C-R194-02 (Medium, test only):** the guard test (ST8b) missed that form. It only looked 14 lines past each field tag and did not follow class constants.
- The gate skipped round 194, so the work from rounds 193 and 194 is still uncommitted on HEAD `caa09af`. Nothing was marked მზადაა; STORE-2a stays ბაგია.

**Round 195 task (D-29z160, 7 files granted, 1017 files frozen):**
- **Guest form:** the two `/support` fields get the same stronger border as the other store fields. A may use the lighter `border-dim` for both if the stronger border reads below 3:1.
- **R80, recordings pages:** the 4 shared field styles in `app/components/recordings/` get the same swap. That folder is store scope: it is not on the forbidden or Studio-owned lists. Those pages need the backend, so C's browser checks there are BLOCKED and only the source test covers them.
- **R82, guard test:** ST8b now reads each whole field tag and follows same-file constants. A new self-test (ST8c) checks known bad and good cases. A may also fix the code reviewer's minor test issues #4–#6 in that file.
- **What C checks:** the guest form at 3 viewports (all four edges ≥ 3:1, keyboard focus still brass, error state unchanged), a spot re-check of two earlier fields, contrast, keep-list, layout, Studio pixels, purchase protection, test mutants m14–m18, and scope. Expected `git status` is 24 modified + 2 new files.
- **If C passes:** root publishes rounds 193–195 together. The regression round comes at the next planning on or after 2026-10-27, then STORE-2b.

**Why I'm confident the list is complete this time:** I wrote a new field scanner (`b-round-194/tools/fieldscan2.mjs`) that reads whole tags and follows constants of any form. It finds exactly 14 faint fields, all inside this round's grants.

**Other updates:**
- **Queue:** the three entries Saba approved on 2026-10-26 (`PHASE2B-SPOTTING`, `STUDIO-AGENT-COMMANDS`, `RECORDING-META-S1`) were missing. I appended them at the end of the queue, in that order, without starting them.
- **Retro notes:** I recorded `B-R194-K0-SCAN-GAP`, because this is the second STORE-2a round lost to an incomplete file list in my own planning. A's code reviewer's architecture note (two separate source walkers in the test file) is parked as a signal for the STORE-2 exit, not scheduled.
- **For Saba, vetoable:** R76–R78 (popup button text colour, placeholder colour, stronger store field borders, now including the guest form) and R80 (recordings pages count as store scope).

The advisor was available and I used it twice: before writing, and before finishing. The second call caught three task-text defects, which I fixed. No app source was changed: the frozen-file hashes and `git status` are the same as at the start.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- tasks/round-194.md
- b-round-194.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
- b-round-194-r195-grants.txt
- b-round-194-r195-tree-sha256.txt
